android.desc:
LableWise is your reliable companion for managing allergies and sensitivities, specifically designed to help users quickly identify allergens in food and other products. Whether you or someone you care for is affected by conditions like Eosinophilic Esophagitis (EoE), Celiac Disease, or other food allergies, LableWise is here to make life easier.

Our app is optimized to detect common allergens, such as: Dairy, Wheat, Gluten, Fish.

While our primary focus is on food allergens, LableWise isn't limited to that. It can also scan product labels across categories, helping you identify unwanted elements, ingredients, or constituents. The app simplifies label-reading, ensuring you have peace of mind when selecting products.

We are committed to making LableWise as helpful as possible. If you have ideas for improvement or additional features, we encourage you to share your feedback directly within the app. Together, we can make navigating allergens and sensitivities effortless.

Download LableWise today and take the stress out of allergen management.

quotes.title: Product Labels Scanner to make life easier for people with allergies
